cause_quote: The new `stored.maxSeq === priorMaxSeq` check, whose only exception requires the current CLI writer to have covered the transcript tip, rejected the watermark advanced by Gateway compaction and caused replay to return no history.
user_saw: After Gateway compaction succeeded, the next fresh CLI turn forgot the previous conversation.
summary: The fix carries verified CLI account provenance forward to the new transcript watermark after successful compaction of the same transcript, so fresh turns recover the saved summary and retained messages.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit's parent, where fresh CLI preparation loaded compacted history and existing tests checked that the saved summary and retained messages reached the history prompt. PR #140294 added a coverage gate that treated compaction writes outside the CLI writer as unknown history and blocked the existing replay path. The evidence bundle reports the same post-compaction failure before and after PR #168244, which restored stateless replay before compaction.
